race.title: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: COCK AND BULL stepped up on his previous hurdling efforts when justifying strong support at Thurles 3 days and, with the longer trip not expected to be an issue, he looks capable of defying a 7-lb penalty and notching up a quick-fire double. King Of The Greys is another that arrives on the back of an improved win and is feared most, while the similarly unexposed pair The Rebel Fox and Tiger Twins are also capable of being involved if taking the required steps forward. COCK AND BULL (IRE) KING OF THE GREYS (IRE) THE REBEL FOX (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Cock And Bull (13/8), King Of The Greys (9/2), Jackmoon (11/2), Big Debates (7/1), The Rebel Fox (8/1), John The Diva (8/1), Political Stance (10/1), Its Not Over Yet (11/1), Drumconnor Hill (14/1), Custers Mistake (16/1), Ney (16/1), Toor Khov (20/1), Tiger Twins (33/1), Bergamasquo (33/1), The Miracle Man (33/1), Strange Currency (50/1), West Of Bally (50/1), Scotty Joe (66/1), Born Bright (66/1)
